1.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
1.name: Increase ATK

2.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
2.name: Increase DEF

3.description: The target's Critical Rate will be increased by 30%.
3.name: Increase CRI Rate

4.description: Critical Hit Rate against the monster is reduced by 50%
4.name: Increase CRI Resist

5.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
5.name: Increase ATK SPD

6.description: The target's HP will be recovered by 15% on each turn.
6.name: Recovery

7.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
7.name: Counter

8.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
8.name: Immunity

9.description: The target will be invincible and receive no damage.
9.name: Invincible

10.description: The target will return 30% of the incoming damage to the attacker when attacked.
10.name: Reflect DMG

11.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
11.name: Shield

12.description: The target's HP will not drop below 1 even when attacked.
12.name: Endure

13.description: The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
13.name: Defend

14.description: The target will revive with 30% HP when defeated.
14.name: Soul Protection

15.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
15.name: Increase ATB

16.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
16.name: Increase Glancing Hit Chance

17.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
17.name: Decrease ATK

18.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
18.name: Decrease DEF

19.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
19.name: Decrease ATK SPD

20.description: All beneficial effects will be blocked
20.name: Beneficial Effects Blocked

21.description: When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.
21.name: Bomb

22.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.
22.name: Provoke

23.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
23.name: Sleep

24.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
24.name: Continuous DMG

25.description: The target will be frozen and won't be able to attack.
25.name: Freeze

26.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
26.name: Stun

27.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
27.name: Unrecoverable

28.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
28.name: Silence

29.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
29.name: Brand

35.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
35.name: Remove Buff

36.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
36.name: Ignore DEF

38.description: Detonate all bomb effects on the enemy target(s)
38.name: Detonate Bomb

39.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself
39.name: Steal Buff

40.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
40.name: Reduce Cooltime

41.description: Puts the target's skill on cool down.
41.name: Increase Cooltime

42.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
42.name: Self-Heal

43.description: Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.
43.name: Anti-Revive

44.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
44.name: Transfer Debuff

45.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
45.name: Additional Attack

46.description: Increases the duration of a buff by a number of turns.
46.name: Increase Buff Duration

47.description: Decreases the duration of debuffs by a number of turns.
47.name: Decrease Debuff Duration

48.description: Deals damage to the monster using the skill.
48.name: Self-Harm

49.description: The skill always has an elemental advantage regardless of monster elements.
49.name: Elemental Advantage

50.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.
50.name: Ally Attack

52.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
52.name: Decrease Damage

53.description: Increases the duration of one or more debuffs on the enemy
53.name: Increase Debuff Duration

55.description: The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
55.name: Threat

57.description: Attack will always land as a Critical Hit
57.name: Guaranteed Critical Hit

58.description: Increases damage per debuff on the target
58.name: Debuff Bonus Damage

59.description: Reduces the remaining time of an enemy's beneficial effect.
59.name: Decrease Buff Duration

60.description: Bypasses all enemy resistances when applying effects.
60.name: Ignore Resistance

61.description: You can possess up to 5 Knowledge, and you can use a skill by consuming the Knowledge (for Lightening Emperor only)
61.name: Knowledge

62.description: You'll be uncontrollable under this state and be defeated when this effect ends.
62.name: Magic Power Explosion

64.description: Recovers HP by 20% of the inflicted damage.
64.name: Vampire

65.description: Immediately apply the remaining Continuous Damage, consuming the effect
65.name: Detonate Continuous Damage

66.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
66.name: Absorb ATB

67.description: Deals increased damage per positive effect on target monster
67.name: Buff Bonus Damage

68.description: Seals the enemy in the scroll, leaving the enemy out of the battle for a designated period of time.
68.name: Scroll Seal

69.description: Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.
69.name: Harmful Effect Removal Blocked

71.description: The HP is reduced by 50% of the MAX HP if the target uses a skill with cooldown time, and the MAX cooldown time of the used skill is increased by 3 turns.
71.name: Suppression

72.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 25% of the MAX HP and cannot recover HP whenever the target's turn returns. The target defeated from the curse cannot be revived and this effect cannot be removed.
72.name: Curse of Death

74.description: MAX HP increases by given amount under certain conditions
74.name: Accumulate MAX HP

75.description: ATK increases by given amount under certain conditions
75.name: Accumulate ATK

76.description: DEF increases by given amount under certain conditions
76.name: Accumulate DEF

77.description: Removes a buff from target monster and applies it to the casting monster.
77.name: Transfer Buff

78.description: Under Berserk state, Defense is decreased by 30%, the damage dealt to enemies is increased by 100%, Attack Speed is increased by 20% and HP is recoverd by 10% of the damage dealt.
78.name: Berserk

79.description: Increases Buff power by certain amount, i.e. Attack Power Buff gives more attack power
79.name: Increase Buff

80.description: Decreases Buff power by certain amount, i.e. Attack Power Debuff reduces more attack power
80.name: Decrease Buff

81.description: 1 Soul Stone will be consumed to revive the ally with 20% HP when an ally dies.
81.name: Soul Stone

82.description: You cannot Critical Hit enemy targets.
82.name: Cannot Critical Hit

85.description: Decreases Attack Bar decreasing effects received
85.name: Decrease ATB effects

86.description: Reflects harmful effects granted on the Monster excluding inability effects.
86.name: Reflect Harmful Effect

87.description: The Demon Bag devours the target to leave it out of the battle and decreases its HP by 5% whenever the enemy and ally's turn ends.
87.name: Demon Bag

89.description: Return a % of the incoming damage to the attacker when attacked.
89.name: Passive Reflect DMG

91.description: Immune to Attack Bar decreasing effects
91.name: Immune to ATB decreasing effects

92.description: This attack won't land as a glancing hit
92.name: Guaranteed Not Glance Hit

93.description: Decreases the chance of being attacked with a Critical Hit
93.name: Decrease Critical Hit Chance

94.description: The target under the Irresistible effect cannot resist any types of harmful effects.
94.name: Irresistible

95.description: Target's HP is reduced by an amount
95.name: HP reduction

96.description: Limits the number of harmful effects allies have in battles (boss battle excluded)
96.name: Limit Harmful Effects

98.description: Ignores all effects that resist death
98.name: Ignores Resist Death

100.description: While under the Seal state, set effects of Despair, Vampire, Violent, Nemesis, Revenge, Destroy, and Seal Runes are not activated.
100.name: Seal

101.description: SPD increases by given amount under certain conditions
101.name: Accumulate SPD

102.description: Any harmful effect that was once applied cannot be reapplied in the same battle.
102.name: Prevent Harmful Effect Reapply

104.description: Monsters under this effect cannot be revived during battle. Does not apply to bosses.
104.name: Unrevivable

105.description: Sacrifice proportionate to the damage taken by all enemies and allies on the battlefield accumulates in the Arsenal. When a unit dies, the Arsenal instantly becomes full.
105.name: Sacrifice

106.description: When Cursed Tombstone is on the enemy side, the HP of an enemy that gets a turn decreases by 15%. Cursed Tombstone will disappear if the enemy at the spot is revived or if the caster dies, and it will not appear in boss battles.
106.name: Cursed Tombstone

107.description: When Cherished Tombstone is on the ally side, increases the Attack Speed of all allies by 50%, and recovers the HP of all allies by 10% at the start of your turn. Cherished Tombstone will disappear if the ally at the spot is revived or if the caster dies.
107.name: Cherished Tombstone

108.description: Decreases chance of being granted with harmful effects
108.name: Decrease Harmful Effect Chance

110.description: Skill has a limited number of usages per battle.
110.name: Skill Limit per Battle

112.description: Becomes immune to Defense decreasing effects
112.name: Immune to Defense Decreasing Effects

113.description: Prevents enemies from receiving beneficial effects.
113.name: Prevent Beneficial Effect

114.description: The unit reduces its own attack speed.
114.name: Reduce Attack Speed

115.description: Reduces the enemy's HP upon activation of a condition.
115.name: Reduce Enemy HP

116.description: The unit lowers its own HP.
116.name: Reduce HP

117.description: The unit cannot be put under the Sleep inability effect.
117.name: Immunity to Sleep

118.description: Increased chance of receiving a Glancing Hit from the enemy
118.name: Receive Glancing Hit Increased

119.description: Takes a percentage of the damage that other allies receive
119.name: Share ally damage

122.description: Gains immunity against HP recovery disturbance effects
122.name: Immune to HP Recovery Disturbance

126.description: Attack Bar increasing effects are not activated
126.name: Blocked Attack Bar Increasing Effects

127.description: Increases the damage that all allies deal to the marked target by 25%. The caster absorbs the Attack Bar by 20% whenever attacking the marked target.
127.name: Mark

128.description: Shares your MAX HP with an ally
128.name: Share MAX HP

129.description: The Attack Bar decreasing effect ignores immunity.
129.name: Decrease ATB Ignores Immunity

130.description: If the target with the shadow trap gains a turn, you will gain the turn instead. This effect can apply up to 2 targets at the same time.
130.name: Shadow Trap

132.description: While in the mechanical frame state, you gain immunity against inability effects and Attack Bar decreasing effects, and deal 50% increased damage. However, you cannot counter attack or attack together. You cannot be defeated while the effect lasts, but will die once the effect ends.
132.name: Mechanical Frame State

133.description: Not affected by cooldown increasing or decreasing skills
133.name: Immune against cool down effects

134.description: Removes all harmful effects on all allies, increases their Attack Bar by 30%, and revives all allies with 30% HP. The cooldown increases by 2 turns per revived ally.
134.name: Enhanced Immortal Light

135.description: The Monster in the [Stealth] state cannot be selected as a target but can be attacked by area attacks and attacks unrelated to target selection. [Stealth] is no longer possible if there is only 1 Monster to select.
135.name: Stealth

137.description: Increases Attack Bar increasing effects received
137.name: Increases ATB effects

138.description: Whenever the target is hit with a single-target attack, 50% of the damage from the first hit is dealt to all other enemies. The tie effect can be applied to one target at a time, and gets untied if either the tied enemy or you get defeated.
138.name: Shadow Tie

139.description: After attacking, you leave the battle until your next turn.
139.name: Leave Battle

140.description: Grants a random harmful effect that was applied on the current battle
140.name: Random Harmful Effect in Battle
